iti17:1.1: 7 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti17:2.1: sekhassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato bāhiraṃ aṅganti karitvā na aññaṃ ekaṅgampi samanupassāmi evaṃ bahukāraṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā
iti17:2.2: kalyāṇamitto bhikkhave bhikkhu akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāvetīti.
iti17:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
